study_id.description: Unique underlying-study identifier; primary legal sources also receive an identifier.

title.description: Display title of the selected source version.

inclusion.description: Empirical local-assignment denominator: included, excluded, pending.

inclusion_reason.description: Evidence and reason for the scope decision.

primary_source_id.description: Preferred source version; source_id in the extraction inventory.

family_status.description: provisional or verified; provisional grouping is not a final paper denominator.

family_note.description: Reason for grouping versions; historical estimates remain version-specific.

source_id.description: Unique source version in the extraction inventory.

version_role.description: primary, linked_supplement, earlier_version; primary source selected in studies.

mapping_basis.description: Explicit version-link rationale; no fuzzy matching at build time.

study_id.description: One current review decision per study family.

reviewer.description: Person or system responsible for the coding decision.

review_note.description: Scope of completed work and outstanding document checks.

diagnostic_id.description: Unique positive diagnostic record; one claim may support several diagnostics.

claim_id.description: Foreign key to exact passage and source version.

geographic_resolution.description: Reported resolution or not_coded; does not imply statewide coverage.

coding_status.description: extracted or rechecked; rechecked means source passage checked, not replication.

coding_note.description: What was inspected and what this record establishes.

sample_size.description: Number of units in this diagnostic; blank means not yet coded or not reported.

n_groups.description: Number of geographic groups used by this diagnostic; blank means unresolved or inapplicable.

statistic.description: Reported statistic or descriptive measure; not_coded until inspected.

null_hypothesis.description: Authors’ tested null, not_coded, or not_applicable_descriptive.

reported_p_value.description: Reported p-value on [0,1]; blank means unresolved or inapplicable.

rejection_level.description: Authors’ stated rejection threshold on (0,1); blank means unresolved or inapplicable.

replication_status.description: not_attempted, reproduced, or discrepancy; source inspection is not reproduction.

diagnostic_type.description: Method key; combined with target forms the primary key.

coverage.description: direct, partial, not_targeted; logical scope, not a power estimate.

rationale.description: Reason for scope judgment; paper-specific design can alter this judgment.

state.description: Normalized state identifier; one state per row.

cycle_start.description: First election year explicitly covered; blank means unresolved.

cycle_end.description: Last election year explicitly covered; blank means unresolved, not current year.

office.description: Office being allocated; gp_head in current coding.

category.description: Exact reservation category; combined categories not silently split.

pool.description: Allocation pool; not_resolved means scope cannot be confirmed.

component.description: Aspect being compared, such as ranking_measure or selection.

value.description: Normalized substantive description, retained alongside original wording.

scope_status.description: provisional or verified; verified requires source/version and scope checking.

account_left.description: First account ID; pair order is canonicalized by pipeline.

scope_review.description: pending or complete; complete required for confirmation.

reason.description: Evidence for resolution, including period, pool, version and conditional rules.

claim_id.description: Assignment or identifying claim being supported.

supporting_claim_id.description: Claim recording the supporting evidence or cited account.

target.description: procedure or identification; balance does not validate a literal allocation algorithm.

note.description: Scope of the evidentiary link; unlinked claims remain unassessed, not unsupported.
